packageRules.description: Test-only infrastructure ships nothing to production, so a bad version can only turn the required 'Build and Test (.NET)' check red, which already blocks the merge. That makes these self-policing, so all update types automerge including majors. Testcontainers.MsSql is referenced solely by DotNetAgentSurface.Hangfire.SqlServer.Tests.
Build-time only: polyfill source generators, SourceLink, versioning and reproducible-build SDKs emit nothing at runtime, so a bad version fails the build rather than reaching production.
Pre-1.0 SDK whose minors still break; patches only until it stabilises.
Toon.DotNet is a leaf serialization helper; a breaking change surfaces as a compile error or a failing test.
